name: Panama City, Panama

visa.notes: One of the easiest retirement visas worldwide

rent.notes: 2026 guides give 2BR at 1200-2500 citywide, with a furnished city-center 2BR averaging about 1200. Range kept. Expect a one-time pet fee of around 450 for a large dog.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Panama City (2026) - Panama Home Realty
Cost of Living in Panama 2026 - ExpatDen
Renting with a pet - Expat.com forum

electricity.notes: Naturgy/ENSA. A/C is primary cost — runs year-round in tropical climate. 7% ITBMS applies.

gas.notes: Propane (tanque) for cooking only. No natural gas infrastructure.

water.notes: IDAAN (national water authority). Very affordable residential water. No ITBMS on residential water.

sewage.notes: Billed with water or included in municipal services.

utilities.taxes: ITBMS 7% on electricity (included in bill). Water/sewer exempt for residential.
utilities.notes: A 2BR running several A/C units uses 120-200+ in electricity. Water, garbage and sewer add 10-25 and propane about 5-8. Internet excluded.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Panama City 2026 - Vidala guide
Panama Utilities and Electricity Costs - Relofirm

healthcare.notes: Private health insurance premiums for two adults age 60-61. Min is two Family Medical Plan memberships ($117.30 each, ages 60-69); typical and max reflect 2026 local quotes of $6,000-10,000/yr for a couple age 60. Premiums are national and age-rated. Pensionado discounts apply to services, not premiums.

sources.title: Panama Relocation Tours - Health insurance options in Panama
Feather - Health insurance in Panama guide (Jul 2026)
Reside Panama - Healthcare in Panama 2026

petDaycare.notes: Hired pet sitter 2 days/week (~$22/visit). Some commercial facilities in Panama City but limited for large breeds. Expat-run pet sitting services available. Pensionado discounts may apply.

transportation.notes: ExpatDen puts car costs at 100-200 per month including fuel (91-octane 1.279/L, Oct 2026). A no-car Metro plus ride-hail budget is 80-150. Car insurance runs 500-900 per year.

entertainment.notes: Mas Movil 600 Mbps fiber is 39 plus 7% ITBMS, about 42. No 1 Gbps price is published. Mid-range dining runs 15-30 per person plus a 10% tip. Streaming and activities are estimates.

phoneCell.notes: Tigo and Mas Movil standard postpaid plans are 27 per line, so two lines are about 54 plus tax. Unlimited LTE plans run 20-30 per line.

medicalOOP.notes: Private GP visits run 15-80 and specialists 50-120. Stored range kept for two adults, assuming a few visits plus labs per month.
